caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned object resembling an oval trivet or grate. The object is rendered in various shades of brown, giving it a metallic or wooden appearance. It is oval in shape, and within the perimeter, there is a symmetrical, radiating pattern consisting of eight elongated, leaf-shaped openings. The edges of the object are slightly scalloped, and there is a small protrusion at the bottom center of the oval. The background is entirely plain and off-white, with no additional elements or textures. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten name, “Margaret Golden.”
title: Trivet
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
